root_cause.text: KVM incorrectly used the L2 RIP from vmcb12 as the NextRIP for vmcb02 during nested state restore (save/restore) even after L2 had been executed, causing the wrong return address for soft interrupts/exceptions because hardware/KVM had already updated NextRIP during L2 execution.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "after L2 runs the first time, NextRIP will be updated by the CPU and/or KVM, and the current RIP is no longer the correct value to use in vmcb02. Hence, after save/restore, use the current RIP if and only if a nested run is pending, otherwise use NextRIP." The patch adds condition `!svm->nested.nested_run_pending` to distinguish the initial VMRUN from later states.
